title: Could be thicker but otherwise a decent product!
text: Could be thicker but otherwise a decent product!. The product looks well made as far as quality but I was hoping they would be thicker to really provide actual comfort when standing for long periods. They were a bit darker then represented in the pictures, but that was a welcome thing for me I was worried they might be too light for my color scheme. All in all, happy with purchase and will update if any issues arise upon cleaning and use. Didn’t seem to take long for the rolled up corners to relax either.
